main.description: Get the requester's membership of this AppView, and the private-tier features it serves. Requires auth. An eligible requester (an active account on a community PDS this AppView serves, while it has room) is enrolled by this call, as by loading the timeline, whether or not this AppView indexes public data. The answer concerns only the requester.

status.description: 'member': a ready member; the private read methods serve the requester. 'indexing': enrolled, and the account's initial indexing is still running; the response carries a Retry-After header, a polling hint rather than an estimate. 'notEligible': not enrolled now. It means "not now", not "never": a refusal is remembered for up to an hour (for example while the requester's PDS is unreachable, or while this AppView is full), and the requester may ask again on a later session.

features.description: The private-tier feature families this AppView serves, whatever the requester's status. Empty when the private tier is disabled. Known values: 'private' (the app.nearhorizon.private read methods); 'private.embeds' (facets, embeds, langs, labels and audience on private post views); 'private.bookmarks' (the app.nearhorizon.private bookmark methods and viewer.bookmarked); 'private.gates' (threadgates and postgates on private posts: threadgate on a thread root, viewer.replyDisabled, hidden replies, viewer.embeddingDisabled and detached quotes); 'private.interactions' (counts and viewer state on private post views, getLikes, getRepostedBy, getQuotes, repost items and thread mutes of private roots); 'private.notifications' (the app.nearhorizon.private notification methods: listNotifications, getUnreadCount, updateSeen); 'private.freshIndex' (app.nearhorizon.index.requestRecord answers caughtUp, and with caughtUp true the caller's private posts read at once); 'private.paging' (sealed cursors on getAuthorFeed, getTimeline and getReplies that page past posts the requester cannot read, so a short or empty page can carry a cursor; the filter parameter of getAuthorFeed; app.nearhorizon.private.getReplies); 'private.crossPdsReplies' (replies under another account's audience are served when anchored to that account's post in the thread, on any PDS); 'private.following' (the `following` audience mode: read by the accounts its owner follows, once the AppView has compared those follows with the owner's repository); 'private.search' (app.nearhorizon.private.searchPosts, a scan at query time over the recent private posts the requester may read); 'private.threadAudience' (a reply is read by its thread root's current audience, or its branch root's in a private branch under a public post, while its writer and every writer above it stand under that audience; chains are walked up to this AppView's max_chain posts; a paged read reads at most twice its limit, so a short page can carry a cursor). Later values name further families; a client ignores values it does not know.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: This AppView's hourly enrolment limit is reached. The response carries Retry-After; ask again after it.
